summary: The first stop is the POT_BLINDNESS arm in potion.c:peffect_blindness(). JavaScript peffects() throws at that arm before the C path draws the blindness duration, updates HBlinded, emits the blindness message, and advances the quaff. Port the whole function and wire its existing peffects() case. The recorded mission then reaches a separate apply.c:use_unicorn_horn() path; js/apply.js has no UNICORN_HORN case, so horn curing is a subsequent blocker outside this first-stop scope.

source.branch: When peffects() receives POT_BLINDNESS for a quaffed potion, peffect_blindness() increments gp.potion_nothing if Blind is already effective or timed blindness is blocked, then calls make_blinded(itimeout_incr(BlindedTimeout, rn1(200, 250 - 125 * bcsign(otmp))), !Blind). For this recorded path the hero is sighted and the potion is uncursed, so bcsign is 0, the recorded rn2(200)=56 makes rn1 return 306, and make_blinded is asked to start blindness with feedback.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1333-1425 peffects() dispatches POT_BLINDNESS to peffect_blindness() at 1389-1391; dopotion() calls peffects() at 624 and consumes the result through its potion_nothing, identification, and useup tail.
js/potion.js:1148-1223 peffects() is the matching dispatcher, but its POT_BLINDNESS case at 1193-1194 throws UnsupportedQuaffError; js/potion.js:dopotion() calls peffects() at 1241.
Runtime command path is js/cmd.js quaff dispatch -> runQuaffCommand() -> js/potion.js:dodrink() -> dopotion() -> peffects(); the selected replay takes this path.
dependencies: potion.c:itimeout_incr() at 67-71; the pure timeout helper is already implemented in js/potion.js:378-380 and clamps the incremented timeout to TIMEOUT.
potion.c:make_blinded() at 261-331; js/potion.js:466-566 already owns the timed BLINDED property, feedback, and vision transition used by this path.

evidence: The saved queue entry and challenges/evaluations/20260926122253-v7.json (evaluated at f7e48bd93d6827c557c9a40a255a55cbc5fc8fcf) identify synthetic/v7/unicorn-horn-blindness-corrected with 26 unmatched screens, 31/57 matched screens, and first stop at segment 0 step 31: “quaffing requires peffect_blindness()”.

challenges/cases/v7/unicorn-horn-blindness-corrected.session.json normalizes to one segment (seed 70727130; moves create a cursed potion of blindness, quaff it, then wish for and apply an uncursed unicorn horn). At step 30 the quaff prompt selects inventory item “o”; step 31 records C rng rn2(200)=56 at peffect_blindness(potion.c:1078), then shows “A cloud of darkness falls upon you.” and a Blind status. This is the runtime reachability evidence for the current first-stop function.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1072-1080 defines the complete function: conditionally increments gp.potion_nothing, computes a BUC-adjusted 200-turn duration with rn1, adds it to BlindedTimeout through itimeout_incr, and calls make_blinded with talk enabled only when the hero was not already Blind. potion.c:1389-1391 wires it from peffects(); potion.c:624 and 635-641 show dopotion() resets gp.potion_nothing before dispatch and later handles the flag before useup().

The relevant state contract is in nethack-c/upstream/include/youprop.h:87-103: HBlinded is u.uprops[BLINDED].intrinsic, EBlinded is extrinsic, BBlinded blocks blindness, Blind is effective blindness, and BlindedTimeout is only the TIMEOUT field. JavaScript stores this property at state.u.uprops[BLINDED], and dopotion() resets state.gp.potion_nothing before peffects().

js/potion.js:1193-1194 is the exact throw that stops replay before the C rn2(200) draw. The called helpers are already implemented at js/potion.js:378-380 and :466-566, so the actionable missing source unit is peffect_blindness() plus replacing the matching dispatcher refusal with its call.

The mission’s later horn action is a separate source gap: upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/apply.c:2259-2387 implements use_unicorn_horn(), called by doapply() at 4371; js/apply.js:2293-2370 has no UNICORN_HORN arm. This is downstream of the current stop and should be investigated after the potion path is restored.
